response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang background, but the role requires deep, current C++ expertise for industrial automation. His only professional C++ experience was a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, and he shows no exposure to IEC 62443, SDL practices, MQTT, or industrial protocols. Despite solid seniority and some high-performance systems experience, the core skill mismatch is too large for this position.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience across diverse stacks and domains
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, event-driven architecture)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, and community teaching (workshops, talks)
concerns: Minimal and outdated professional C++ experience (~6 months, ended 2015); primary languages are TypeScript/Node.js/DLang
No industrial automation, IEC 62443, SDL, MQTT, or OT protocol experience (Modbus, OPC UA, DNP 3.0, etc.)
Career trajectory is web/product-focused, suggesting poor alignment with an embedded/industrial C++ role
